title: Green Queen and Lavender Fields
description: A green-skinned queen with a flaming golden crown and purple facial markings looks to the right, while a curly-haired person in a hooded robe sits beside her gazing upward. The scene is set in a purple lavender field with crystal formations under a cosmic sky featuring planets, a red sun, geometric mountains, and a floating purple bat-like alien creature.
prompt: A green-skinned queen wearing an ornate golden crown with flames and flowers, purple markings on her face, looks to the right. In the foreground a curly-haired person in a hooded robe sits looking up at her. They are in a vast field of purple lavender with glowing crystals and geometric mountains in the background. A purple bat-like alien creature with big eyes floats in the cosmic sky filled with swirling galaxies, a large red sun, and planets. Detailed line art with selective vibrant coloring.
